Only open items appear here; healthy stock is not listed. Severity (8-week rule): out of stock + nothing inbound + sales in last 30d = critical; days of cover under lead time = critical; under 56 days (8 weeks) = urgent; 56 to 69 days = watch; 70+ healthy. Days of cover = FBA available / 30-day velocity (FBA + FBM units). Lost rev is a rough estimate = the item's best observed daily sales rate (highest 30d sales / 30 across tracked weeks) x days out of stock. Days OOS counted in whole weeks from snapshot history, so it steps up 7 days at a time. Blank = no sales on record. Restock: green = Amazon FBA recommendation (restock_recs.csv). Grey "est." = velocity x (56 days + lead time) x event lift, minus available and inbound, rounded up; lead time 5d US, 14d CA, 45d UK/EU/AE/SA/AU. Event lift applies when Prime Big Deal Days, Black Friday or Cyber Monday falls inside the next 56 days (hover the estimate for the lift). Owner "client" = NIC creates the shipment.
